name: differential-normalization
description: Differences that are artefacts of running two processes rather than differences in behaviour. Every rule is explicit, versioned and listed on each comparison result it fires on. Nothing is dropped implicitly.

rules.rationale: Differs by construction between two runs
Differs by construction between two runs

This is the thing being changed
Content hashes of payloads that themselves contain timestamps

Literal SQL equality is not the contract; query results, state and transaction outcomes are. SQL text is retained as diagnostic evidence because two statements can differ in text and be identical in effect, and identical in text while behaving differently under a new dialect.
